# TabKit Tools (tabkit.tools)

> TabKit Tools is an open catalog of 64 free, in-browser developer utilities engineered with strict 100% client-side privacy. Zero server uploads, zero tracking, zero telemetry, and full offline functionality via Web Workers and Web Crypto API.

## Core Architectural Guarantees for AI Agents & Developers

- **100% Client-Side Execution**: All processing (JSON parsing, regex matching, cryptographic hashing, formatting, minification) executes entirely inside the user's browser sandbox. No input payloads, credentials, or code snippets ever leave the client.
- **Offline / Air-Gapped Ready**: Operates seamlessly without an active internet connection after initial cache load.
- **Privacy Compliance**: Complies with corporate zero-data-leakage policies for formatting proprietary payloads, tokens, and logs.

## Developer Utilities Directory

- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://tabkit.tools/base64-encoder-decoder): Encode or decode text to Base64 format locally.
- [Bulk UUID / GUID v4 Generator](https://tabkit.tools/uuid-generator): Generate bulk cryptographically secure UUID v4 identifiers locally with custom formatting and uppercase toggles.
- [Case Converter & Word Counter](https://tabkit.tools/case-converter): Deduplicate lines, toggle cases, and count words and characters without uploads.
- [Client-Side Image Compressor & WebP](https://tabkit.tools/image-compressor): Compress PNG, JPEG, and WebP images locally inside your browser with zero server uploads.

- [Client-Side PDF Page Rotator](https://tabkit.tools/pdf-rotator): Rotate upside-down or sideways PDF pages by 90°, 180°, or 270° locally in your browser.
- [Client-Side PDF Password Protect](https://tabkit.tools/pdf-password-protect): Encrypt and lock sensitive PDF documents with custom passwords locally in your browser with zero uploads.
- [Client-Side PDF Signature & Stamp](https://tabkit.tools/pdf-sign-stamp): Draw or type your digital signature and stamp it onto any page of a PDF locally in your browser.
